name: Minankari enamel earrings
about: Minankari is a Georgian enamel art style with fine colored patterns on metal. It is a traditional craft closely linked to Tbilisi's artisans.
tip: Check that the silver is real and ask whether the enamel is hand-made.

name: Kvevri Georgian wine
about: Kvevri wine is made by fermenting grapes in large clay jars buried in the ground. Georgia has used this method for thousands of years.
tip: Check the grape variety and whether the bottle is an amber wine, which has skin contact.

name: Churchkhela
where: Badagi official shop or Dezerter Bazaar
about: Churchkhela is a candy made from nuts strung on a thread and dipped in thickened grape juice. It is a classic Georgian snack sold across the country.
tip: Check the production date and look for no added coloring.
